messages.subject: For Tone Skuterud | Sustainability, renewable energy and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Steen,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Tone Skuterud, Executive Vice President, People, Organisation and Sustainability.

Statkraft's renewable-energy portfolio depends on disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability commitments and project teams. That operating interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining environment undergoing its own energy transition.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams, while maintaining senior institutional relationships. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of sustainability, government relations, stakeholder strategy and operator-side renewable-energy experience might support Statkraft's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Statkraft.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
